description:
Bradford Enviroseal ProctorWrap Black Label with Integrated Tape
(BL-IT) is a premium, Light Duty vapour-permeable wall wrap specifically
designed for use behind open-joint rainscreen facades where high water hold-out
and superior UV resistance are required. Manufactured with a unique functional
coating that provides enhanced temperature resistance up to 120°C and long-term
UV durability for facades with up to 30% open area, it comes equipped with an
integrated adhesive tape system with release liners for fast, airtight lap
sealing. It permits water vapour to escape from building interiors while forming
a continuous weather and air barrier behind architectural claddings.
features:
Engineered for open-joint rainscreen facades with up to 30% open
area

Integrated adhesive tape (BL-IT) with release liner eliminates the need
for separate joining tapes

Outstanding UV stability and high temperature
resistance up to 120°C

High water hold-out resisting liquid water ingress and
driving rain

Highly vapour permeable (Class 4) allowing controlled moisture
escape

Robust spunbond polyolefin construction resistant to wind flap and
tears

Suitable for timber and steel frame commercial and residential
facades

Assists in achieving airtight building envelopes for superior energy
efficiency
Low flammability index compliant with AS 1530.2

rag_summary:
Bradford Wall Wraps - Black Label With Integrated Tape (Enviroseal ProctorWrap
BL-IT, product code 106703) is a specialized Light Duty, Class 4
vapour-permeable wall wrap engineered for open-joint rainscreen facades.
Manufactured with a high-temperature functional UV coating that withstands
temperatures up to 120°C, it is rated for facades with up to 30% open joint
area. Equipped with an integrated adhesive lap tape system, it seals building
envelopes against wind-driven rain and air leakage while allowing interior
moisture vapour to breathe freely, complying with AS/NZS 4200.1 and AS 1530.2
(Flammability Index ≤ 5).

description:

adhesive sealing tape featuring a flexible synthetic carrier designed to create
durable air and watertight seals on construction membranes. Formulated with a
solvent-free, high-grab adhesive, it adheres aggressively to vapour-permeable
wall wraps, aluminium foil sarking, timber, steel, plastics, and masonry. It is
specifically engineered to seal overlaps, penetrations, window flashings, and
pipe junctions to ensure the integrity of the building envelope.

rag_summary:
Bradford
Wall Wraps - Enviroseal Hightack Tape (product code 155170) is a premium 60mm
x 25m single-sided adhesive tape featuring an aggressive, solvent-free acrylic
adhesive on a flexible polyolefin carrier. Engineered specifically for sealing
laps and penetrations on Enviroseal vapour-permeable membranes and Thermoseal
sarking, it creates airtight and watertight barriers across diverse construction
substrates including timber, steel, PVC, and foil. Operating reliably from -40°C
to +80°C with zero chlorine or formaldehyde, it is essential for achieving
blower-door airtightness and weather protection in modern energy-efficient
envelopes.

description:

high-performance, linerless woven polymer fabric sealing tape designed for the
fast, waste-free joining and sealing of vapour-permeable wall wraps and roof
sarking. Engineered with a heavy-duty cold-weather adhesive and a robust woven
backing, it delivers exceptional initial grab and shear strength across
Australian climatic conditions. The linerless design eliminates release paper
waste on building sites, while the hand-tearable construction allows rapid,
blade-free installation on scaffolding and ladders.

rag_summary:
Bradford Wall Wraps - Enviroseal Ultra Tape (Bradford ULTRAtape,
product code 471825) is an advanced 60mm x 25m linerless, hand-tearable woven

eliminates the rubbish and frustration of backing paper on construction sites

reliably from -20°C to +80°C and fully compliant with AS/NZS 4200.2, it

description:
Bradford Enviroseal ProctorWrap Commercial Wall (CW) is a
premium, Light Duty vapour-permeable wall wrap engineered specifically for
commercial timber and steel-framed wall construction. Composed of a spunbond

that allows moisture vapour from inside the building to escape, while preventing
wind-driven rain and air infiltration from penetrating into the wall cavity.
With higher material weight and tensile strength than standard residential
wraps, it is certified for use with commercial claddings, brick, steel,
fibre-cement, and Hebel systems.

rag_summary:

description:

face to reduce installation glare. Installed adjacent to an air cavity, it
provides dual reflective thermal R-values while acting as a water barrier,
vapour barrier, and draft-reducing membrane in metal residential and light
commercial buildings.

rag_summary:
Bradford Wall Wraps - Light Duty Metal Roof (Bradford
Thermoseal Roof Metal Wall, product codes 105871 / 15056) is a reinforced
reflective foil laminate sarking engineered for metal-clad roofs and external
walls. Combining kraft paper, reinforcing fibreglass scrim, and pure aluminium

description:

Acting as a water barrier against wind-driven rain and an effective air barrier

homes built with brick veneer, timber weatherboards, fibre cement, or composite
cladding.

rag_summary:
Bradford Wall Wraps - Medium Duty Polyweave Wrap
(Bradford Thermoseal Wall Breather, product codes 15123 / 101254) is a
micro-perforated, high-strength woven polyweave reflective wall wrap designed
for brick veneer and lightweight framed walls. Engineered with a tough woven
polymer core and reflective aluminium foil, it provides exceptional tear
resistance against high site winds while its micro-perforations permit water
vapour transmission to prevent trapped cavity moisture. Providing radiant
thermal insulation across wall airspaces and achieving a Flammability Index ≤ 5
(BAL 12.5-40 compliant), it offers robust weather and thermal protection for
residential envelopes.

high-density, polymer-based asphalt-free synthetic soundproofing membrane
engineered to deliver exceptional airborne and impact noise reduction without
increasing structural thickness. Highly visco-elastic and adaptable, it acts as
an acoustic damping mass that breaks up structural resonance in drywall
partitions, ceilings, timber floors, metal roofs, and building service
enclosures. Distributed in Australia by DCTech, it is available in standard,
self-adhesive (SY), and composite felt (2FT) configurations.

rag_summary:
DCTech Acoustic Barrier (Tecsound / Tecsound SY) is a
high-density, visco-elastic synthetic soundproofing membrane distributed in
Australia by DCTech. Formulated from asphalt-free polymers at 5.0 kg/m²
(Tecsound 50, 2.5mm) and 7.0 kg/m² (Tecsound 70 / SY 70, 3.5mm), it provides an
Rw of up to 30 dB as a single layer without adding significant wall or ceiling
thickness. Available with a self-adhesive backing (SY) or composite felt (2FT),
it dampens airborne noise, aircraft flyover rumble, and metal roof rain drumming
across walls, ceilings, floors, and building services. Rated Euroclass B, s2,
d0, non-toxic, and flexible down to -20°C, it is an advanced acoustic damping
membrane for high-performance building envelopes.

description:
DCT XPS GA 300 is a closed-cell, high-compressive-strength,
low-moisture-absorption extruded polystyrene (XPS) general application rigid
insulation board for roofs, walls, and floors in commercial and residential
buildings. Manufactured in accordance with EN 13164 with zero Ozone Depletion
Potential (ODP) and CFC/HCFC-free blowing agents, it offers exceptional
compressive strength of 300 kPa and long-term dimensional stability. It
maintains superior thermal performance even under extreme conditions of
compressive loading, ground moisture, and freeze-thaw cycles.
features: High compressive strength minimum 300 kPa (average 350 kPa to AS 2498.3)
Closed cell structure provides near-zero water absorption (< 0.3% by volume)

Long-term thermal performance with low thermal conductivity (0.028 - 0.034
W/m·K)

Specially designed tongue and groove edge profile for airtight,
continuous thermal layering

High resistance to freeze-thaw cycles and ground
moisture

Rot-proof, dimensionally stable, and resistant to compression creep
up to 50 years

Lightweight, rigid, and clean to handle and cut with a knife
or saw
Zero ODP, CFC and HCFC free formulation compliant with Green Star

Suitable for inverted roofs (IRMA), green roofs, under-slab, cavity walls, and
cold stores

rag_summary:
DCTech DCT XPS GA (DCT XPS GA 300) is a rigid,
high-compressive-strength (300 kPa) extruded polystyrene insulation board
engineered for under-slab, inverted flat roof (IRMA), green roof, and cavity
wall applications. Featuring a 100% closed-cell structure with near-zero water
absorption (<0.3%) and tongue-and-groove edges, it delivers durable thermal
performance (conductivity 0.028-0.034 W/m·K) that resists compression creep,
ground moisture, and freeze-thaw degradation over a 50-year design life.
Manufactured with zero ODP and CFC/HCFC-free blowing agents, it provides
high-load thermal buffering beneath concrete slabs and protected membrane
roofs.
